India Infrastructure Fund Attracts Global Investors

India's National Investment and Infrastructure Fund (NIIF) is reportedly aiming to raise a $3.2 billion infrastructure fund. Global investors are showing interest in India's growth story. Canada Pension Plan Investment Board (CPPIB) and Teachers Pension Plan Investment Board are part of an investor group contributing $2 billion to India's state-backed infrastructure fund. This development highlights international confidence in India's infrastructure sector.
